Converts `self` into a [`Right`](https://docs.rs/either/1/either/enum.Either.html#variant.Right) variant of [`Either<Self, Self>`](https://docs.rs/either/1/either/enum.Either.html) otherwise. # `iced_widget::canvas::path::lyon_path::geom::euclid`

A collection of strongly typed math tools for computer graphics with an inclination towards 2d graphics and layout.

All types are generic over the scalar type of their component (`f32`, `i32`, etc.), and tagged with a generic Unit parameter which is useful to prevent mixing values from different spaces. For example it should not be legal to translate a screen-space position by a world-space vector and this can be expressed using the generic Unit parameter.

This unit system is not mandatory and all structures have an alias with the default unit: `UnknownUnit`. for example `default::Point2D<T>` is equivalent to `Point2D<T, UnknownUnit>`. Client code typically creates a set of aliases for each type and doesn’t need to deal with the specifics of typed units further. For example:

```rust
use euclid::*;
pub struct ScreenSpace;
pub type ScreenPoint = Point2D<f32, ScreenSpace>;
pub type ScreenSize = Size2D<f32, ScreenSpace>;
pub struct WorldSpace;
pub type WorldPoint = Point3D<f32, WorldSpace>;
pub type ProjectionMatrix = Transform3D<f32, WorldSpace, ScreenSpace>;
// etc...
```

All euclid types are marked `#[repr(C)]` in order to facilitate exposing them to foreign function interfaces (provided the underlying scalar type is also `repr(C)`).

## Modules

- [`approxeq`](approxeq/index.md) *(std or libm)*
- [`approxord`](approxord/index.md) — Utilities for testing approximate ordering - especially true for floating point types, where NaN’s cannot be ordered.
- [`default`](default/index.md) — A set of aliases for all types, tagged with the default unknown unit.
- [`num`](num/index.md) — A one-dimensional length, tagged with its units.

## Structs

- [`Angle`](struct.Angle.md) — An angle in radians
- [`BoolVector2D`](struct.BoolVector2D.md) — A 2d vector of booleans, useful for component-wise logic operations.
- [`BoolVector3D`](struct.BoolVector3D.md) — A 3d vector of booleans, useful for component-wise logic operations.
- [`Box2D`](struct.Box2D.md) — A 2d axis aligned rectangle represented by its minimum and maximum coordinates.
- [`Box3D`](struct.Box3D.md) — An axis aligned 3D box represented by its minimum and maximum coordinates.
- [`HomogeneousVector`](struct.HomogeneousVector.md) — Homogeneous vector in 3D space.
- [`Length`](struct.Length.md) — A one-dimensional distance, with value represented by `T` and unit of measurement `Unit`.
- [`Point2D`](struct.Point2D.md) — A 2d Point tagged with a unit.
- [`Point3D`](struct.Point3D.md) — A 3d Point tagged with a unit.
- [`Rect`](struct.Rect.md) — A 2d Rectangle optionally tagged with a unit.
- [`RigidTransform3D`](struct.RigidTransform3D.md) — A rigid transformation. All lengths are preserved under such a transformation.
- [`Rotation2D`](struct.Rotation2D.md) — A transform that can represent rotations in 2d, represented as an angle in radians.
- [`Rotation3D`](struct.Rotation3D.md) — A transform that can represent rotations in 3d, represented as a quaternion.
- [`Scale`](struct.Scale.md) — A scaling factor between two different units of measurement.
- [`ScaleOffset2D`](struct.ScaleOffset2D.md)
- [`SideOffsets2D`](struct.SideOffsets2D.md) — A group of 2D side offsets, which correspond to top/right/bottom/left for borders, padding, and margins in CSS, optionally tagged with a unit.
- [`Size2D`](struct.Size2D.md) — A 2d size tagged with a unit.
- [`Size3D`](struct.Size3D.md) — A 3d size tagged with a unit.
- [`Transform2D`](struct.Transform2D.md) — A 2d transform represented by a column-major 3 by 3 matrix, compressed down to 3 by 2.
- [`Transform3D`](struct.Transform3D.md) — A 3d transform stored as a column-major 4 by 4 matrix.
- [`Translation2D`](struct.Translation2D.md) — A 2d transformation from a space to another that can only express translations.
- [`Translation3D`](struct.Translation3D.md) — A 3d transformation from a space to another that can only express translations.
- [`UnknownUnit`](struct.UnknownUnit.md) — The default unit.
- [`Vector2D`](struct.Vector2D.md) — A 2d Vector tagged with a unit.
- [`Vector3D`](struct.Vector3D.md) — A 3d Vector tagged with a unit.

## Traits

- [`Trig`](trait.Trig.md) — Trait for basic trigonometry functions, so they can be used on generic numeric types

### `impl<T> Downcast for T where T: Any,`

#### `into_any`

```rust
fn into_any(self: Box<T>) -> Box<dyn Any>
```

Convert `Box<dyn Trait>` (where `Trait: Downcast`) to `Box<dyn Any>`. `Box<dyn Any>` can then be further `downcast` into `Box<ConcreteType>` where `ConcreteType` implements `Trait`.

#### `into_any_rc`

```rust
fn into_any_rc(self: Rc<T>) -> Rc<dyn Any>
```

Convert `Rc<Trait>` (where `Trait: Downcast`) to `Rc<Any>`. `Rc<Any>` can then be further `downcast` into `Rc<ConcreteType>` where `ConcreteType` implements `Trait`.

#### `as_any`

```rust
fn as_any(&self) -> &(dyn Any + 'static)
```

Convert `&Trait` (where `Trait: Downcast`) to `&Any`. This is needed since Rust cannot generate `&Any`’s vtable from `&Trait`’s.

#### `as_any_mut`

```rust
fn as_any_mut(&mut self) -> &mut (dyn Any + 'static)
```

Convert `&mut Trait` (where `Trait: Downcast`) to `&Any`. This is needed since Rust cannot generate `&mut Any`’s vtable from `&mut Trait`’s.

### `impl<T> DowncastSync for T where T: Any + Send + Sync,`

```rust

```

Convert `Arc<Trait>` (where `Trait: Downcast`) to `Arc<Any>`. `Arc<Any>` can then be further `downcast` into `Arc<ConcreteType>` where `ConcreteType` implements `Trait`.

# `iced_winit::Error`

```rust
pub enum Error {
    ExecutorCreationFailed(Error),
    WindowCreationFailed(OsError),
    GraphicsCreationFailed(Error),
}
```

An error that occurred while running an application.

**Source:** [error.rs](../src/iced_winit/error.rs.md) (lines 6-18)

## Variants

### `ExecutorCreationFailed(Error)`

The futures executor could not be created.

### `WindowCreationFailed(OsError)`

The application window could not be created.

### `GraphicsCreationFailed(Error)`

The application graphics context could not be created.

# `iced_winit`

A windowing shell for Iced, on top of [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit).

![The native path of the Iced ecosystem](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/blob/0525d76ff94e828b7b21634fa94a747022001c83/docs/graphs/native.png?raw=true)

`iced_winit` offers some convenient abstractions on top of [`iced_runtime`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/master/runtime) to quickstart development when using [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit).

It exposes a renderer-agnostic [`Program`] trait that can be implemented and then run with a simple call. The use of this trait is optional.

Additionally, a [`conversion`](conversion/index.md) module is available for users that decide to implement a custom event loop.

## Re-exports

- [`Clipboard`](clipboard/struct.Clipboard.md)
- `pub use iced_debug as debug;`
- `pub use iced_program as program;`
- `pub use iced_runtime as runtime;`
- `pub use program::core;`
- `pub use program::graphics;`
- `pub use runtime::futures;`
- `pub use winit;`

## Modules

- [`clipboard`](clipboard/index.md) — Access the clipboard.
- [`conversion`](conversion/index.md) — Convert [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) types into [`iced_runtime`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/master/runtime) types, and viceversa.

## Structs

- [`Proxy`](struct.Proxy.md) — An event loop proxy with backpressure that implements `Sink`.

## Enums

- [`Error`](enum.Error.md) — An error that occurred while running an application.

## Functions

- [`build_user_interfaces`](fn.build_user_interfaces.md) — Build the user interface for every window.
- [`run`](fn.run.md) — Runs a [`Program`] with the provided settings.
- [`user_force_quit`](fn.user_force_quit.md) — Returns true if the provided event should cause a [`Program`] to exit.

# `iced_winit::conversion`

Convert [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) types into [`iced_runtime`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/master/runtime) types, and viceversa.

## Functions

- [`cursor_position`](fn.cursor_position.md) — Converts a physical cursor position into a logical `Point`.
- [`fullscreen`](fn.fullscreen.md) — Converts a [`window::Mode`] into a [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) fullscreen mode.
- [`icon`](fn.icon.md) — Converts some [`window::Icon`] into its `winit` counterpart.
- [`ime_purpose`](fn.ime_purpose.md) — Converts some [`input_method::Purpose`] into its `winit` counterpart.
- [`key`](fn.key.md) — Converts a `Key` from [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) to an [`iced`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/0.12) key.
- [`key_code`](fn.key_code.md) — Converts a `KeyCode` from [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) to an [`iced`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/0.12) key code.
- [`mode`](fn.mode.md) — Converts a [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) fullscreen mode into a [`window::Mode`].
- [`modifiers`](fn.modifiers.md) — Converts some `ModifiersState` from [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) to an [`iced`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/0.12) modifiers state.
- [`mouse_button`](fn.mouse_button.md) — Converts a `MouseButton` from [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) to an [`iced`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/0.12) mouse button.
- [`mouse_interaction`](fn.mouse_interaction.md) — Converts a [`mouse::Interaction`] into a [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) cursor icon.
- [`native_key_code`](fn.native_key_code.md) — Converts a `NativeKeyCode` from [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) to an [`iced`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/0.12) native key code.
- [`physical_key`](fn.physical_key.md) — Converts a `PhysicalKey` from [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) to an [`iced`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/0.12) physical key.
- [`position`](fn.position.md) — Converts a [`window::Position`] into a [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) logical position for a given monitor.
- [`resize_direction`](fn.resize_direction.md) — Converts some [`window::Direction`] into a [`winit::window::ResizeDirection`].
- [`theme_mode`](fn.theme_mode.md) — Converts a [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) window theme into a [`theme::Mode`].
- [`touch_event`](fn.touch_event.md) — Converts a `Touch` from [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) to an [`iced`](https://github.com/iced-rs/iced/tree/0.12) touch event.
- [`user_attention`](fn.user_attention.md) — Converts some `UserAttention` into its `winit` counterpart.
- [`visible`](fn.visible.md) — Converts a [`window::Mode`] into a visibility flag.
- [`window_attributes`](fn.window_attributes.md) — Converts some [`window::Settings`] into some `WindowAttributes` from `winit`.
- [`window_event`](fn.window_event.md) — Converts a winit window event into an iced event.
- [`window_level`](fn.window_level.md) — Converts a [`window::Level`] into a [`winit`](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit) window level.
- [`window_theme`](fn.window_theme.md) — Converts a [`theme::Mode`] into a window theme.
